**Original comment by agriggio (Bitbucket: [agriggio](https://bitbucket.org/agriggio), GitHub: [agriggio](https://github.com/agriggio)).**

----------------------------------------

The copyright was there \(see [https://bitbucket.org/agriggio/art/src/f67518114c6fa25cba6c55399359436a6d711312/rtengine/canon\_cr3\_decoder.cc?at=master#lines-30](https://bitbucket.org/agriggio/art/src/f67518114c6fa25cba6c55399359436a6d711312/rtengine/canon_cr3_decoder.cc?at=master#lines-30)\), but indeed it was imprecise. I never meant to imply that I did any work on this, sorry if this is the impression you got.

I have now made it more explicit \(see [https://bitbucket.org/agriggio/art/commits/43eab7b8da7d49398cf2345331ce7c4f71014ebf](https://bitbucket.org/agriggio/art/commits/43eab7b8da7d49398cf2345331ce7c4f71014ebf)\), can you please check that it is fine now? Thanks! and sorry for the mistake, I know how annoying such kind of misattribution can be.
